final: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END as signed_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')), account_flows AS (SELECT account_id, region, SUM(signed_amount) as net_flow, COUNT(*) as num_transactions FROM filtered_trans GROUP BY account_id, region), total_flow AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(net_flow AS REAL)) as total_net_flow FROM account_flows) SELECT af.account_id, af.region, af.net_flow, af.num_transactions, CAST(af.net_flow AS REAL) / tf.total_net_flow as share FROM account_flows af CROSS JOIN total_flow tf ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
